# Placerville Dentistry

> > A comprehensive dental practice in Placerville, California offering implant dentistry, oral surgery, cosmetic dentistry, and general dental care with flexible financing and insurance options.

Placerville Dentistry is led by Dr. Barinder Cheema and Dr. Navneet Kaur Sehgal, offering a full range of dental services supported by experienced hygienists like Nick Franco. The practice accepts numerous major dental insurance plans and provides multiple financing solutions including in-office options.

## Dental Insurance Plans

- [Dental Insurance - Placerville Dental Group](https://placervilledentistry.com/our-practice/dental-insurance): Overview of accepted dental insurance providers at Placerville Dental Group.
- [Aetna - Placerville Dental Group](https://placervilledentistry.com/our-practice/dental-insurance/aetna): Aetna dental insurance plans: HMO, PPO, Indemnity, and Hybrid options.
- [Ameritas - Placerville Dental Group](https://placervilledentistry.com/our-practice/dental-insurance/ameritas): Ameritas Classic PPO dental programs accepted in California.
- [Anthem BlueCross - Placerville Dental Group](https://placervilledentistry.com/our-practice/dental-insurance/anthem-bluecross): Anthem BlueCross dental insurance: Dental Blue, Prime, and Enhanced plans.
- [Blue Shield - Placerville Dental Group](https://placervilledentistry.com/our-practice/dental-insurance/blue-shield): Blue Shield PPO dental health insurance plan with dentist flexibility.
- [Cigna PPO - Placerville Dental Group](https://placervilledentistry.com/our-practice/dental-insurance/cigna): Cigna PPO dental insurance with preventive and restorative coverage.
- [Delta Dental - Placerville Dental Group](https://placervilledentistry.com/our-practice/dental-insurance/delta-dental): Delta Dental employer-based plans for Placerville employees.
- [Delta Dental Individual - Placerville Dental Group](https://placervilledentistry.com/our-practice/dental-insurance/delta-dental-individual): Delta Dental individual coverage including DHMO plans.
- [First Dental Health - Placerville Dental Group](https://placervilledentistry.com/our-practice/dental-insurance/first-dental-health): First Dental Health affordable PPO and EPO programs in California.
- [Guardian - Placerville Dental Group](https://placervilledentistry.com/our-practice/dental-insurance/guardian): Guardian dental insurance plans: PPO coverage with in-network benefits.
- [Humana - Placerville Dental Group](https://placervilledentistry.com/our-practice/dental-insurance/humana): Humana individual and group dental plans including military options.
- [MetLife - Placerville Dental Group](https://placervilledentistry.com/our-practice/dental-insurance/metlife): MetLife employer-based dental insurance with large provider network.
